f2bd55fab0.en: Should I tip on the pre-tax or post-tax amount?

a7de6df1e2.en: Either is acceptable. Tipping on the pre-tax subtotal is the more common custom, because sales tax is a government charge rather than a payment for service. Tipping on the post-tax total adds a little more. Use the toggle to compare.

50fc74c03f.en: How is the per-person amount calculated?

86d8de5620.en: The total bill plus tax and tip is divided by the number of diners in whole cents. Any leftover cents go to the first diners, one cent each, so the shares add up to the exact total.

8cb2101156.en: What is an automatic gratuity for large parties?

3304ea0072.en: Many restaurants add a fixed service charge, often 18% to 20%, for parties of six or more. Under IRS Revenue Ruling 2012-18 a mandatory charge like this is a service charge rather than a voluntary tip, so check the bill before adding more.

014cc650ee.en: What does the rounding option do?

463c7b87be.en: Exact cents keeps every amount to the cent. Round total moves the tip so the grand total is a whole dollar. Round tip rounds only the tip to a whole dollar.

e2d524da46.en: How does the custom ratio split work?

e27f2921fe.en: Enter one weight per diner, such as 2, 1, 1. Each diner pays their weight divided by the total weight of the total bill, again in whole cents.

b271ab5f4c.en: Work out the tip, sales tax and total, then split the check between any number of diners. The split runs in whole cents, so every share adds back to the exact total with no missing pennies.
